name: Feel Energy | 10mg Seltzer | Dragon Fruit Lime
description: Bright, exotic, and irresistibly crisp—our Dragonfruit Lime sparkling drink is your perfect midday pick-me-up. Infused with 10mg THC and 30mg of caffeine from organic green tea, it delivers a clean, balanced boost without the jitters. With just 20 calories per 12oz can, it's low-calorie, non-GMO, vegan, and gluten-free. Naturally sweetened with agave and bursting with light, tropical flavor, it’s the ultimate refreshment with benefits.
